title: Supplier Registration and Pre-Qualification
description: Letshego Faidika Bank (microfinance/inclusive finance arm) invites suppliers and service providers to register and apply for pre-qualification via the bank's Supplier Registration and Pre-Qualification Form. The bank conducts periodic supplier registration, assessment, qualification and segmentation. Completed forms with supporting documentation should be submitted to the Procurement and Logistics unit.

contact.name: Procurement and Logistics Unit
contact.address: Plot No.23, Ursino Estate / Vodacom Tower, Paloma Park, P.O. BOX 6137, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania

eligibility: Open to all prospective suppliers and service providers. Form must be completed in English with all required supporting documentation.
